allowances: The hall bonds 0.22 into the NW tower and the kitchen 0.05 into the North tower. Both are built against the curtain/towers, and these are reported, not failures. Wall stairs may touch their host wall but not penetrate it. No allowance applies to any yard area, fixture or route.
remaining_limits: Training action/standing space is architectural planning space only. Combat, movement mechanics and in-game behaviour are not tested.
Clearances are exact for convex polygons and circles. Routes and gate axes are sampled every 0.1 cell; reachability uses a 0.25 grid flood.
W2 stands 0.6 off the SE curtain rather than against it. This is not a clip, but it reads as freestanding.
Several margins are tight (0.09 to 0.22) by design (abutting stairs, 3-wide gates with a 2.4 approach reserve).
The wall walk (+7), closed-gate state, building interiors beyond Part A, and kitchen-yard storage (none is drawn) are untested.
This is a 2D proposal. It has no navmesh, camera, height or structural test, and no game implementation.
